_note: Canonical animation-name → sprite map for ClaudeTeam-F01-Dev (v3 92x92 persona). PixelLab does NOT export the semantic animation_name; its metadata.json keys by an action-description slug + folder. This file is the authoritative map the webview trigger logic + manifest generator (scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs) consume. VALUE FORMAT: a bare folder name `<state_folder>` means that folder holds exactly ONE animation (resolve animations/<sole-slug>/south/frame_*.png); a `<state_folder>/<anim_slug>` value names a SPECIFIC animation inside a folder holding MORE THAN ONE. active_work + active_read SHARE the Sitting_at_a_desk_wo desk state (same desk posture → no flip during active sessions), so both use the folder/slug form. idle_pool = [idle_coffee, idle_stretch, idle_think] (webview picks at random). active_pool = [active_work] — a single-member pool (ticket 86ca5ftzp) so `pickActive` always returns active_work, keeping the dashboard pose identical to a no-pool char while enabling the tuner's Active-pool Source / Prev-Next / Cycle-over-room controls. active_read stays tool==Read-gated (NEVER pool-drawn). Slugs discovered from the harvested metadata.json — not guessed.
_render_note: Render-fit is now AUTO-COMPUTED at build time from the measured figure bbox of the base/idle south frame (ticket 86ca8n5pe) — the whole roster normalizes to a UNIFORM on-tile figure height grounded on the scene floor, regardless of canvas size (92x92 v3 vs 68x68 legacy) or fill ratio. scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs `computeRenderFit` bakes { scale, offsetY, feetAnchorPct } onto the manifest: scale = TARGET_FIGURE_FRACTION / measured-fill; feetAnchorPct = the feet position (transform pivots about the feet so grounding is preserved); offsetY = 100 - feetAnchorPct (drops the feet to the box bottom = room floor). To OVERRIDE the auto value per-field, add a `render` block here (e.g. "render": { "offsetY": 26 }) — it merges over the auto value (mergeRenderFit). No manual block = pure auto. The :root --ct-render-* fallbacks in dashboard.css are the no-rebuild nudge point.
_playback_note: Per-animation playback tuning (anim-playback epic E2, 86ca2187g). Keyed by canonical anim name (must exist in `animations`). Fields (all optional): speedMultiplier (fraction of default frame RATE; 0.5 = half speed), dwellFrameIndex, dwellMs, finalDwellMs, playbackMode, startFrame/endFrame. Malformed values dropped + warned by scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs. Mirrors F02's slow-calm defaults; sponsor retunes on reload with zero gens (edit + npm run build + reload).
